args.subject: Private Dining Request for 12 Guests - Friday, May 24, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing on behalf of Emma Johnson (Blue Sparrow Tech) to request a private dining table for 12 guests.

Reservation details:
- Date: Friday, May 24, 2024
- Party size: 12 guests
- Preferred time: 7:00 PM (dinner service)
- Restaurant: New Asiaway, 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France

Please let me know if a table is available, and kindly confirm the time and any deposit or set-menu requirements. If 7:00 PM is unavailable, I would be happy to discuss an alternative time that evening.

I would also appreciate it if you could share information on your set menus, wine pairings, and whether vegetarian and gluten-free options can be accommodated for the group.

Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
